title: Von Braun's team passed data to Argentine Nazis in Mexico

tellings.quote: >> that they were going in meeting Nazi counterparts coming from Argentina at border towns in Mexico and giving them data drops.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher who writes about Nazi-era secret projects, told podcast host Jesse Michels about the team of Wernher von Braun, the German rocket scientist brought to America after World War II. Jorjani says that in the late 1940s members of that team, then working in Texas, went to border towns in Mexico to meet Nazi counterparts coming from Argentina and hand them data. If true, it would mean secret research kept flowing to Nazis abroad after the war.
